models_evaluated: in-house developed ambient digital scribing tool

links.outcome: Ambient scribe note quality: fluency, completeness, factuality, and capture of new medications
links.effect: Strengths in fluency and clarity; weaknesses in factual accuracy and in capturing new medications on 40 real clinical visit recordings.
links.quote: Our evaluation revealed strengths, such as fluency and clarity, but also highlighted weaknesses in factual accuracy and the ability to capture new medications.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs as evaluators of ambient scribe output
Simulation testing of ambient scribing tools
Combining human evaluation with automated metrics to assess transcription, diarization, and note generation

screen.reason: The paper proposes an evaluation framework for ambient digital scribing tools and applies it empirically to evaluate a tool's performance on 40 real clinical visit recordings, focusing on evaluation methodology rather than comparing a specific deployment safeguard intervention.
